sources.snippet: Granite Speech Models Model Summary: Granite Speech models are compact and efficient speech-language models, specifically designed for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and automatic speech translation (AST). Granite Speech models use a two-pass design, unlike integrated models that combine speech and language into a single pass.

sources.title: IBM releases Granite Speech 5.0 Turbo CTC models with over 12,600 RTFx ...
sources.snippet: IBM has released two new compact, 470M-parameter English speech recognition models in the Granite Speech family: `granite-speech-5.-470m-turboctc` and `granite-speech-5.-470m-turboctc-nc`. These encoder-only models achieve unprecedented transcription speeds of over 12,600 RTFx on an NVIDIA H200 GPU while maintaining high accuracy.
